_comment: SDXL object-recolour REFINE workflow (ComfyUI API format). Same proven shape as replace_object.json, run at LOW denoise. The init image is the context crop whose footprint has already been recoloured in LAB space by backend/comfy_recolor.py (luminance preserved, so texture/lighting/shadows/highlights/reflections are intact). SDXL then only refines that recolour for natural cohesion — it must not flatten the object, hence the low denoise. The graph STRUCTURE lives here; comfy_recolor.py injects per-request VALUES by node id. Flow: load checkpoint -> encode prompts -> VAE-encode the recoloured crop -> restrict denoising to the footprint via SetLatentNoiseMask -> KSampler refines -> decode -> save. Surroundings stay fixed.

inputs.text: recoloured object, same texture and lighting, photorealistic
flat, plastic, posterized, banding, blurry, lowres, distorted, artifacts, seam, different object, watermark, text
